name: gnomAD constraint metrics (LoF/missense) and pext

version.value: v4.1.2 constraint metrics (TSV.bgz 574.5 MB, 2026-09-23); v4.1 file of 2024-04-18 superseded

scope: Gene and transcript constraint (observed/expected LoF, missense, synonymous; LOEUF), mutation and methylation rate tables, base-level pext.
mapping_methods: Gene/transcript level; join on Ensembl IDs.

quantitative.summary: o/e ratios with confidence bounds, Z scores, LOEUF.

update_frequency: Per gnomAD release; 4.1.2 updated constraint only.
coverage_limitations: Constraint is a population-genetic inference, not a direct knockout phenotype
Short genes have wide confidence intervals
known_omissions: Ensembl also ships a LOEUF plugin file (338 MB); this is the primary source

reuse_decision.rationale: Primary source of record and moderate size; the Ensembl LOEUF file is a derivative of the same resource so is not downloaded separately.

status.notes: S3 object size verified by HEAD.
